pages.name: Slav: Exchange, 8.Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 1 exchanged on f6 with Nxf6 or Bxf6, moves no piece can make; plan 2 wrote White's dxe5 into a Black sequence. Rewrote plans 1-2 around Nxc6, Bb5/Qa4 and ...Nd7. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav Defense: Chebanenko Variation
pages.notes: Plan 3 answered 5.c5 with ...Ne8-d6 and a kingside pawn storm instead of ...Bf5, ...Nbd7 and ...e5. Rewrote plan 3; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav Defense: Chebanenko Variation, Advance System
pages.notes: Plan 4 rerouted a knight d7-b8-c6. Rewrote plan 4 around ...Bf5, ...Nbd7, ...e5 and ...b6. British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Slav: Chameleon, 5.e3 b5
pages.notes: Plan 2 broke with d4-d5 onto Black's d5-pawn. Rewrote plan 2 around c5, b3 and a4. British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Chameleon, 5.e3 b5 6.b3
pages.notes: Plan 2 named White's e4 in a Black plan and put the bishop on b7 behind the c6- and d5-pawns; plan 4 spoke vaguely of a minority attack. Rewrote plans 2 and 4; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav Defense: Smyslov Variation
pages.notes: Overview and plan 2 aimed at a c2-pawn that is on c4, and the overview and plan 1 built the line on a ...b5 break that a4 makes unsound (first overview rewrite rejected for holding the c4-pawn; rewrote overview and plan 1 around ...Bg4, ...e6 and ...Nb4 and re-accepted). British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Bronstein, 6.Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 1 wrote f2-f3 and g2-g4 onto the bishop's square; plan 2 promised pins that do not exist. Rewrote both; British spelling.

pages.name: Slav: Bronstein, 6.Ne5 Bh5 7.f3
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...e5 with the knight on e5; plan 4 wrote the f3-g4 advance as a route. Rewrote both; British spelling in the overview.

pages.name: Slav: Bronstein, 6.Ne5 Bh5 7.g3
pages.notes: Plan 3 said h4 harasses the h5-bishop; plan 4 played ...e5 with the knight on e5. Rewrote plans 2-4.

pages.name: Slav: Smyslov, 6.Ne5
pages.notes: Plan 2 played ...e7-e5 with the knight on e5 and said the a6-knight controls c7; plan 4 fianchettoed the light-squared bishop to b7 behind the c6-pawn. Rewrote the overview and plans 2 and 4; British spelling.
